sloka: मयूखैः उपसर्पद्भिः हिम नीहार संवृतैः ।दूरम् अभ्युदितः सूर्यः शशांक इव लक्ष्यते ॥३-१६-१८॥
transliteration: mayūkhaiḥ upasarpadbhiḥ hima nīhāra saṁvṛtaiḥ ।dūram abhyuditaḥ sūryaḥ śaśāṁka iva lakṣyate ॥3-16-18॥

translations.english: The Sun risen at the distant horizon looks like the Moon, his lengthening rays covered with snow and dew.
